issues.t: Shifter can reach Park while still in gear
issues.sym: The shifter shows Park but the car is not truly held in Park, so it may creep or roll after you get out.
issues.why: On some cars built in this period the shift cable was fitted incorrectly at the factory, so the lever position and the transmission's actual gear do not match. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Use the parking brake every time you park and have a Kia dealer check your VIN for the shift cable recall right away.

issues.t: Brake lights may stop working
issues.sym: Brake lights do not come on when you press the pedal, cruise control may not cancel with the brake, and a warning light may appear.
issues.why: The switch at the top of the brake pedal can fail internally, so the car no longer knows the pedal is pressed. Kia recalled affected cars to replace the switch.
issues.next: Have someone check that your brake lights work. If they do not, get the recall repair done before driving more than you must.

issues.t: Theta II engine bearing wear, knocking and seizure
issues.sym: A knock or tick that gets faster with engine speed, low oil level between changes, an oil pressure light, power loss, stalling, or the engine locking up.
issues.why: Metal debris left from machining at the engine plant can wear the connecting rod bearings until they fail. Kia recalled 2011-2014 cars, added knock-detection software, and extended engine coverage after a class action.
issues.next: Stop driving if you hear knocking or lose power, and have it towed. Check your VIN for the engine recall and any extended engine warranty, and keep oil change records.

issues.t: Fuel leak after an engine replacement
issues.sym: A strong gasoline smell or fuel dripping in the engine bay, usually on a car that has had its engine replaced.
issues.why: The high-pressure fuel pipe could be damaged or not lined up correctly when a replacement engine was installed, letting fuel escape near hot parts. Kia recalled cars that had engine replacements.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Have the car towed to a Kia dealer and check your VIN for the fuel pipe recall.

issues.t: Airbags may not deploy in a crash
issues.sym: Usually no warning; sometimes an airbag light.
issues.why: The airbag control unit can short out during a crash, which can stop the front airbags and seat belt pretensioners from firing. Kia recalled affected cars, including hybrids.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the airbag control unit recall and have it done as soon as possible.

issues.t: ABS unit can short and catch fire
issues.sym: ABS warning light, a burning smell, or smoke from the engine bay, even when the car is parked and off.
issues.why: Brake fluid can seep into the ABS control unit and cause an electrical short. Kia ran several recalls, adding a new fuse and inspecting the unit, and told owners to park outside until repaired.
issues.next: Park outdoors away from buildings and check your VIN for the ABS recalls. If you smell burning or see smoke, do not drive the car.

issues.t: Headliner trim can come loose when side airbags fire
issues.sym: Usually nothing you would notice in normal driving.
issues.why: Plates holding the headliner may not be properly secured, so they can break free when the side curtain airbags deploy and could hurt someone. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the headliner recall and schedule the free repair.

issues.t: Right front axle shaft can crack and break
issues.sym: Clicking or clunking from the front right when accelerating, then a sudden loss of drive to the wheels.
issues.why: The right front driveshaft on some cars built in late 2015 and early 2016 may crack and separate. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: If you hear new clunking or the car stops moving under power, pull over safely and have it towed. Check your VIN for the axle recall.

issues.t: Driver airbag may not inflate fully
issues.sym: No warning to the driver.
issues.why: On some early 2016 cars the driver's airbag was missing a chemical needed for its second inflation stage, so it may not protect as intended. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the driver airbag recall and get it repaired promptly.

issues.t: Trunk cannot be opened from inside
issues.sym: The glow-in-the-dark trunk release inside the trunk does not open the lid.
issues.why: The base of the trunk latch can crack, so the inside emergency release no longer works. Kia recalled affected cars, including hybrid and plug-in hybrid versions.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the trunk latch recall and have the latch replaced.

issues.t: Hybrid can lose power in electric mode
issues.sym: The car suddenly loses drive power while running on electric power, often with warning lights.
issues.why: A voltage protection device in the hybrid system can trip when it should not, cutting power while driving. Kia recalled affected hybrids for a fix.
issues.next: If power cuts out, steer to a safe spot. Check your VIN for the hybrid power recall and avoid relying on the car until it is fixed.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking may not stop for parked cars
issues.sym: The forward collision system does not brake or warn when approaching a stopped vehicle ahead.
issues.why: A software error could keep the collision-avoidance system from applying the brakes when it detects a stationary car. Kia recalled affected cars for a software update.
issues.next: Do not depend on automatic braking. Check your VIN for the forward collision software recall.

issues.t: Fuel tank can swell, melt and leak
issues.sym: A gasoline smell, a check-engine light, or fuel dripping under the car near the exhaust.
issues.why: A worn check valve in the fuel vapor purge system can let pressurized air from the engine into the fuel tank. The tank bulges until it touches the hot exhaust and melts. Kia recalled affected K5s.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel or see a leak. Check your VIN for the purge valve recall so the valves and any damaged tank are replaced.

issues.t: Crankshaft sensor fault can stall the V6
issues.sym: The engine cuts out while driving or idling, may not restart right away, and a check engine light can come on.
issues.why: The sensor that tells the computer where the crankshaft is was built with a casing that was out of spec. A part on its circuit board can crack, and the engine loses its timing signal. Kia recalled these V6 cars to replace the sensor.
issues.next: A stall in traffic is a safety risk. Check your VIN for this recall and have the sensor replaced before relying on the car.

issues.t: Front subframe can rust through (recall)
issues.sym: Clunks from the front end, steering that pulls or feels loose, or heavy flaking rust on the steel cradle under the engine, mostly on cars driven on salted winter roads.
issues.why: Road salt and water can collect inside the front subframe and rust it from within. If the metal gets weak enough, a suspension arm can pull away from it. Kia issued a recall for this.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and have a shop look at the subframe on a lift soon. Do not keep driving if the front end clunks or the steering changes suddenly.

issues.t: Side airbag wiring can be damaged (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light stays on, or there is no warning at all until a crash.
issues.why: The wiring for the seat-mounted side airbag can get damaged, which can keep that airbag from firing in a side impact. Kia recalled these cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have any airbag light diagnosed right away, since the airbags may not protect you.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may be installed wrong (K5 recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing you can see or feel. The problem only shows up when the curtain airbag does not open the way it should in a crash.
issues.why: On some K5 sedans the side curtain airbags may not have been fitted correctly at the factory, so they might not unfold properly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and book the free inspection soon. The dealer refits the airbags if needed.

issues.t: Dual-clutch transmission can lose drive (K5 GT recall)
issues.sym: Transmission warning messages, then the car stops pulling and coasts, sometimes within seconds of the warning.
issues.why: The oil pump inside the 8-speed dual-clutch transmission can fail. The backup limp mode that should let you keep moving may not work, so drive power is lost.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. If a transmission warning appears, pull over somewhere safe and have the car towed to a Kia dealer.

issues.t: Steering can turn heavy with lane following on (K5 GT recall)
issues.sym: With Lane Following Assist on in a curve, the steering wheel suddenly takes more effort to turn.
issues.why: The power steering software may miss a communication fault, so the steering assist does not adjust as it should while the lane system is steering.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the power steering software recall and keep both hands on the wheel when using lane following until it is done.

issues.t: Rear window trim can come loose and fly off (K5 recall)
issues.sym: The glossy trim piece beside the rear side window looks lifted, rattles or whistles at speed, or is missing.
issues.why: The trim on the rear roof pillar may not be held on well enough and can work loose. A piece that comes off on the road is a hazard to other drivers.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and press on both trim pieces now and then. If one is loose, tape it down and have the dealer replace it.

issues.t: Parking lights can flicker (K5 recall)
issues.sym: The parking lights flicker or pulse instead of staying steadily lit.
issues.why: A software error in the module that manages electrical power can make the parking lights flicker, which makes the car harder for others to see.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and get the free software update, at the dealer or over the air.

issues.t: Instrument display can go blank (K5 recall)
issues.sym: The screen behind the steering wheel goes dark, so the speedometer, tire pressure reading and warning lights are not shown.
issues.why: A software error can make the instrument panel display fail while the car otherwise runs normally.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and get the free software update. If the display goes blank, drive carefully to a safe place and restart the car.
